references.text: Describes the great trials, signs and wonders that God performed against Pharaoh and Egypt
The Lord's outstretched arm as a symbol of his power to deliver Israel from Egypt
The Lord's strong hand that led Israel out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery
Parallel text describing trials, signs, wonders and God's strong hand at the exodus from Egypt
The Lord brought Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, great and awe-inspiring deeds, signs and wonders
A reminder of the Lord's greatness, his strong hand and outstretched arm, the signs and deeds against Egypt
The great trials, signs and wonders that the eyes saw in Egypt
God's signs in Egypt and his wonders on the plains of Zoan
The Lord brought Israel out from Egypt with a strong hand and an outstretched arm
The Lord brought his people out of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm
Moses led the people out and performed wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea and in the wilderness
